LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingJammingReachesRadiosD: On by default. A jammer switched to radios floods the radio bands with noise for a long way around, and every radio there hears it, the colony's own included: talk, remote-driven vehicles, radio-linked turrets and calls home fail as the noise drowns them. A radio close to its station, or a strong one, still gets through, and Morse lasts longest. Turrets linked by cable are untouched. Off: jammers blind radar only, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SheetJamming: Jamming at the receivers: {ATSECOND} at the station, {ATFIRST} at the far end (in the floors above).
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_VehicleWhyJammed: Its radio link is jammed: the noise drowns the station's orders before they reach it.
